paragraphs.text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ;
paragraphs.original: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν θεῷ πατρὶ ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ·
paragraphs.translit: Paulos kai Silouanos kai Timotheos tē ekklēsia Thessalonikeōn en theō patri hēmōn kai kyriō Iēsou Christō·

paragraphs.text: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: charis hymin kai eirēnē apo theou patros kai kyriou Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: We are bound to give thanks to God always to you, brethren, even as it is meet, for that your faith growth exceedingly, and the love of each one of you all toward one another aboundeth;
paragraphs.original: Εὐχαριστεῖν ὀφείλομεν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί, καθὼς ἄξιόν ἐστιν, ὅτι ὑπεραυξάνει ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν καὶ πλεονάζει ἡ ἀγάπη ἑνὸς ἑκάστου πάντων ὑμῶν εἰς ἀλλήλους,
paragraphs.translit: Eucharistein opheilomen tō theō pantote peri hymōn, adelphoi, kathōs axion estin, hoti hyperauxanei hē pistis hymōn kai pleonazei hē agapē henos hekastou pantōn hymōn eis allēlous,

paragraphs.text: so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which ye endure;
paragraphs.original: ὥστε αὐτοὺς ἡμᾶς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐγκαυχᾶσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τοῦ θεοῦ ὑπὲρ τῆς ὑπομονῆς ὑμῶν καὶ πίστεως ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς διωγμοῖς ὑμῶν καὶ ταῖς θλίψεσιν αἷς ἀνέχεσθε,
paragraphs.translit: hōste autous hēmas en hymin enkauchasthai en tais ekklēsiais tou theou hyper tēs hypomonēs hymōn kai pisteōs en pasin tois diōgmois hymōn kai tais thlipsesin hais anechesthe,

paragraphs.text: [which is] a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God; to the end that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
paragraphs.original: ἔνδειγμα τῆς δικαίας κρίσεως τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ καταξιωθῆναι ὑμᾶς τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ, ὑπὲρ ἧς καὶ πάσχετε,
paragraphs.translit: endeigma tēs dikaias kriseōs tou theou, eis to kataxiōthēnai hymas tēs basileias tou theou, hyper hēs kai paschete,

paragraphs.text: if so be that it is righteous thing with God to recompense affliction to them that afflict you,
paragraphs.original: εἴπερ δίκαιον παρὰ θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι τοῖς θλίβουσιν ὑμᾶς θλῖψιν
paragraphs.translit: eiper dikaion para theō antapodounai tois thlibousin hymas thlipsin

paragraphs.text: and to you that are afflicted rest with us, at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of his power in flaming fire,
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς θλιβομένοις ἄνεσιν μεθʼ ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ μετʼ ἀγγέλων δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ
paragraphs.translit: kai hymin tois thlibomenois anesin methʼ hēmōn en tē apokalypsei tou kyriou Iēsou apʼ ouranou metʼ angelōn dynameōs autou

paragraphs.text: rendering vengeance to them that know not God, and to them that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus:
paragraphs.original: ἐν φλογὶ πυρός, διδόντος ἐκδίκησιν τοῖς μὴ εἰδόσι θεὸν καὶ τοῖς μὴ ὑπακούουσιν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: en phlogi pyros, didontos ekdikēsin tois mē eidosi theon kai tois mē hypakouousin tō euangeliō tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou,

paragraphs.text: who shall suffer punishment, [even] eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
paragraphs.original: οἵτινες δίκην τίσουσιν ὄλεθρον αἰώνιον ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: hoitines dikēn tisousin olethron aiōnion apo prosōpou tou kyriou kai apo tēs doxēs tēs ischyos autou,

paragraphs.text: when he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be marvelled at in all them that believed (because our testimony unto you was believed) in that day.
paragraphs.original: ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐνδοξασθῆναι ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ καὶ θαυμασθῆναι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύσασιν, ὅτι ἐπιστεύθη τὸ μαρτύριον ἡμῶν ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς, ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ.
paragraphs.translit: hotan elthē endoxasthēnai en tois hagiois autou kai thaumasthēnai en pasin tois pisteusasin, hoti episteuthē to martyrion hēmōn ephʼ hymas, en tē hēmera ekeinē.

paragraphs.text: To which end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfil every desire of goodness and [every] work of faith, with power;
paragraphs.original: εἰς ὃ καὶ προσευχόμεθα πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἵνα ὑμᾶς ἀξιώσῃ τῆς κλήσεως ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ πληρώσῃ πᾶσαν εὐδοκίαν ἀγαθωσύνης καὶ ἔργον πίστεως ἐν δυνάμει,
paragraphs.translit: eis ho kai proseuchometha pantote peri hymōn, hina hymas axiōsē tēs klēseōs ho theos hēmōn kai plērōsē pasan eudokian agathōsynēs kai ergon pisteōs en dynamei,

paragraphs.text: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: ὅπως ἐνδοξασθῇ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν αὐτῷ, κατὰ τὴν χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hopōs endoxasthē to onoma tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou en hymin, kai hymeis en autō, kata tēn charin tou theou hēmōn kai kyriou Iēsou Christou.
